summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness, evidenced by massive call premiums in SPX, SPXW, and NDX, alongside extremely low Put/Call ratios in GOOGL (0.09) and AMZN (0.06). Significant directional conviction is visible in the massive accumulation of SPX 6000C and 7000C strikes for 2026, alongside SPXW 5500C contracts, totaling billions in premium. Persistent interest is confirmed by multi-day accumulation in the SPX 6000C (exp 2026-05-15) totaling $3.44B and the SPX 7000C (exp 2026-09-18) totaling $699.5M. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the indices and monitor if the heavy call buying in NVDA and QQQ translates into immediate price action or if the high SPY P/C ratio (1.41) signals a short-term hedging hedge.
